name: Fez
registryBasis: Morocco’s ANCFCC lists separate Fès Medina and Fès Zouagha My Yacoub land-conservation and cadastre offices, confirming local cadastral coverage in Fez. Its cadastral-plan ordering service requires personal/organization details, a land-title number, CAPTCHA and SMS verification; it is not an anonymous public feature service.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The public ANCFCC site describes cadastral products and separately lists Fès local cadastre offices, but direct anonymous requests to the cadastral-plan form and the official cartography products page returned HTTP 403. The indexed form requires personal/organization details, a title number, CAPTCHA and SMS verification. No anonymous full parcel geometry route was found and no form was submitted.
scopeLimits: ANCFCC’s official pages and search-indexed content confirm Fès local cadastre/conservation offices and cadastral map products. The public plan-order form is a per-title request requiring identity details and CAPTCHA/SMS. Direct anonymous GETs to the plan form and map-product pages returned 403 from the origin path, so no route/schema/geometry was obtained. No login, form submission, CAPTCHA, or owner lookup was attempted.
remainingUncertainty: A professional cadastral/cartography workspace may provide separate map services, but it is not advertised as an anonymous public parcel map and was not accessed. The public map products reviewed are ordered cartographic products, not a verified machine-readable full-parcel service.
